parameters.name: PreferredLifetime
parameters.description: The time at which this prefix will cease to be preferred (i.e. will become deprecated), or {{null}} if not known. For an infinite lifetime, the parameter value MUST be 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z.

parameters.name: ValidLifetime
parameters.description: The time at which this prefix will cease to be valid (i.e. will become invalid), or {{null}} if unknown. For an infinite lifetime, the parameter value MUST be 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z.

object.description: IPv6 prefixes delegated to this client via IA_PD.
